verdict.rationale: Groq's docs explicitly showcase GPT-OSS 120B as a supported open-weight model, and community reports independently confirm hosting of Llama and Mixtral models plus later Kimi K2, indicating a multi-family open-weight catalog on shared serverless endpoints. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation confirming Qwen or DeepSeek availability, and the models.md page snippet only surfaces one model in detail rather than a full catalog listing. missing for 10: explicit docs listing Qwen and DeepSeek support, and a comprehensive current model catalog page rather than a single model snippet.
